scenarios.description: Green CI with missing evidence is not certifiable
scenarios.evidence: CIEvidenceRecord requires artifact fingerprint; missing artifact = insufficient evidence
scenarios.notes: The CIEvidenceRecord contract requires evidence artifacts; green CI alone is insufficient
Semantic equivalence check fails closed on any dimension mismatch
SHA mismatch causes fingerprint mismatch; evidence is stale
